selection: Diverse selection from 180 eligible candidates; no model outcomes used

persona_diversity.method: Source quotas filled round-robin up to availability; greedy diminishing-return coverage of directional field/value pairs, equal weight per behavioral area and field. Seed breaks ties only.
persona_diversity.limitations: Heuristic diversity, not a global optimum or population-representative sample. Exact categorical values, not semantic distances; missing attributes earn no coverage. No demographic or domain quotas.

task_selection: Seed 20260926 shuffle of asset-ready catalogs with distinct studies; ASI three existing ready instances plus astronomy and biology public CPU instances; EXP five distinct papers.
controls: One fresh persona-off run per task, shared across all 30 profile comparisons; not independent replicates
injection: Exact full profile in simulator system prompt only; general knowledge allowed in both conditions; evaluator references remain private

restart.policy: Fresh runs, no prior scores reused; first two frozen questions per benchmark retained in manifest order

record_note: Frozen study metadata. Machine-local preparation paths omitted; not a launcher manifest. Original records remain in the local completed run.
